finding.summary: The plugin orchestration plan had gate requirements and anti-stop wording, but did not explicitly require the full internal role loop after every executor slice.
cross_stack_plan_had: continuous role loop without stopping execution
review as an internal quality loop
review gaps become immediate execution input
role transition is not a final response
plugin_plan_was_missing: mandatory REVIEW_INTERNAL after each executor slice
mandatory ARCHITECT_INTERNAL_REPAIR for protocol or plan gaps
explicit ban on stopping after review or repair

required_loop_after_patch: REVIEW_INTERNAL compares artifacts to the literal gate and parent matrix
ARCHITECT_INTERNAL_REPAIR patches governing files if review finds a gap
EXECUTOR_INTERNAL_CONTINUE resumes automatically while next_action is non-empty
remaining_next_action: Create and run automated host invocation harness: VS Code extension-development command/chat execution with XIIGEN_WIKI_CONTEXT_HOOK, and Visual Studio experimental-instance command/tool-window invocation with XIIGEN_WIKI_CONTEXT_HOOK; persist per-prompt host evidence.
allowed_claim_after_this_report: Role-loop governance repaired; active plan still in progress.
